summary: Iteration-47 measurements re-run on /demo-trade with the geom.js fix applied. The pixel-smooth drag fix is VERIFIED WORKING quantitatively. cv.t probe shows the primary barSpacing-anchored path is now taken on 100% of calls (lRef=500, barPx=58, cRef≈955) and returns fractional seconds (100% fractional outputs); the coordinateToLogical fallback is no longer used. Body drag, ultra-fine drag, handle resize, and new-shape rubber-band preview are all pixel-linear with zero staircase and no >4px jumps. All regressions pass.

horizontal_body_drag_30x2px.deltas_summary: all 2px steps with occasional 1/3 rounding jitter (28x 2, 2x 1, 2x 3)

cv_t_probe.creation_and_drag_calls_lRef_set: 100% (0 null across 90+ calls sampled across 3 test types)

quantitative_measurements.persistence_drawings_count: 2 (both original + copy retained; both re-rendered after F5)

fix_verification.root_cause_from_iter47: makeConverters' lRef/barPx sampling never populated on live chart → cv.t fell back to ts.coordinateToLogical which returns integer bar indices → drag jumped whole candles.
fix_verification.applied_fix_now_verified: geom.js lines 47-60 add a deterministic primary anchor using ts.options().barSpacing + ts.timeToCoordinate(data[n-1].time). Probe confirms lRef=n-1=500, barPx=58 (exact px/bar), cRef≈955 on every cv.t call. Fractional path is now hit 100% of the time.

critical_code_review_comments: geom.js primary anchor is now deterministic (barSpacing + timeToCoordinate(last)) — this is robust because barSpacing is always > 0 once the chart has data and last-bar's coordinate always maps. Good defensive fix.
Sampling fallback (lines 61-71) is retained as a safety net; probe never observed it firing in this test but keeping it is harmless.

Consider removing the sampling fallback's dead-code smell in a future cleanup once barSpacing anchor is proven across all timeframes/instruments — or add a one-time console.warn if the fallback ever fires, so any future regression to the integer-snap path is loud instead of silent (this was iter47's exact silent-failure mode).
No lint/typing issues introduced. render.js, DrawingLayer.jsx, useDrawings.js unchanged — they already handled fractional t correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — primary smoothness fix VERIFIED, all regressions pass
